content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Wayne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's formal prerequisites—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented project-leadership hours, or equivalent combinations. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications at no cost and identify any gaps before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions remotely on a schedule that fits your work commitments. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world applications over five days of interactive instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your official PMI PMP application with proof of education and experience. Pay the required examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff will clarify which documents you need and answer questions about the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Our support extends through your exam day to ensure you feel confident in the testing format and content.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew your PMP. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways—training courses, volunteering, and published work all count. Plan your PDU strategy early to keep your credential active throughout your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
